theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_radial_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (s ρ : ℝ), 0 < s → s < ρ → ∃ ζ : Rn N → ℝ, (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K ζ) ∧ HasCompactSupport ζ ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.closedBall x ρ ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y ∧ ζ y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x s, ζ y = 1) ∧ (∀ y ∉ Metric.ball x ρ, ζ y = 0) ∧ ∀ G : Set (Rn N), NullMeasurableSet G volume → ∫ y in G, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖ = ((volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal - (volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x s)).toReal) / (ρ - s)
